transcript: First pottery class tonight. The wheel is harder than it looks and everything I touched went lopsided. Going back on Thursday anyway.
Argument with Dario about the move. He wants to decide by the end of the month and I am not ready to say yes or no. We left it unresolved, which is the part that sits badly.
Slept badly three nights running now. Wired at two in the morning, staring at the ceiling, then useless by the afternoon.
Long walk out on the headland. Fog came in off the water and swallowed the path ahead of me. Calmer afterwards than I had been all week.
Standup went badly. The Atlas deadline slipped again and nobody in the room wanted to be the one to say it out loud. I said it.
Dinner with Nonna. She told the boat story again, the one about her father and the crossing, and I let her tell all of it.
Started running again after months off. Two miles, slow, and the knee held up better than I expected it to.
Quit the second coffee. Headaches for two solid days and then, suddenly, nothing. I am counting that as a win.
